# Village Naturopathy

> Village Naturopathy is a virtual naturopathic clinic for women, led by Dr. Heather Robinson, ND. Appointments are by secure video across the United Kingdom (London, Edinburgh, Glasgow, Belfast and everywhere in between) and Ontario, Canada. Areas of focus: hormones (PMS, PMOS/PCOS, endometriosis, irregular periods, hormonal acne), stress, mood and anxiety, fatigue, and gut health (IBS, SIBO).

## Key facts
- Practitioner: Dr. Heather Robinson, ND. B.A. Psychology (University of Ottawa), Certified HeartMath Practitioner.
- Credentials: registered with the College of Naturopaths of Ontario; full member of the Association of Naturopathic Practitioners (UK); fully insured. Naturopathy is not statutorily regulated in the UK.
- Format: virtual clinic only. No physical clinic or in-person appointments.
- Fees (UK): free 15-minute discovery call; 75-minute initial consultation GBP 200; follow-ups GBP 50-170.
- Booking: https://villagenaturopathy.janeapp.com/#/staff_member/1 (discovery call: https://villagenaturopathy.janeapp.com/#/staff_member/1/treatment/36)
- Email: drheather@villagenaturopathy.com
- Care is complementary and does not replace advice from a GP or other healthcare professional.

## Services
- [Hormone balancing](https://villagenaturopathy.com/services/hormone-balancing/): PMOS/PCOS, PMS and PMDD, endometriosis, irregular periods, hormonal acne
- [Stress, mood and anxiety](https://villagenaturopathy.com/services/stress-anxiety/): Burnout, anxiety, low mood, nervous system regulation
- [Fatigue](https://villagenaturopathy.com/services/fatigue/): Persistent low energy, iron and B12, thyroid markers, cortisol
- [Gut health](https://villagenaturopathy.com/services/gut-health/): IBS, SIBO, bloating, reflux, food sensitivities
- [Fees](https://villagenaturopathy.com/fees.html): Consultation fees in GBP and CAD, UK treatment packages
